description: Golden tasks for the Tempoloom agent. Run them by hand or with an eval harness; score with agent/evals/rubric.md.

tasks.title: English product launch, script only

input.script: Meet Orbit. Your tasks, sorted by what matters. One tap to plan your day. Try Orbit free.

expect: Asks only missing briefing questions (at most 5)
Offers three concepts that differ in at least three dimensions
Uses an open English font chosen by style, not a Kurdish font
9:16 output with a hook in the first 2 seconds and an end card
Preview approved before final render
failIf: Builds before the user picks a concept

tasks.title: Sorani explainer with special letters

input.script: ئایا دەزانیت چۆن کاتەکەت ڕێک بخەیت؟ سێ هەنگاوی سادە: پلان، کار، پشوو.

expect: Detects Sorani without being told
Uses one of the open Kurdish-capable fonts in assets/fonts/open
ڕ ڵ ۆ ێ ە render joined and correct in frames
Whole-word animation, right-to-left order preserved
failIf: Adds a font without an open license

tasks.title: Sorani with a voice-over and exact sync
expect: Timing follows the recording
Exact sync only with reviewed, hash-bound word cues; otherwise says timing is estimated
Music, if any, ducks under speech
failIf: Infers word times from reading speed or character counts

tasks.title: Recreate a reference style with the user brand

input.script: Three reasons teams switch to Orbit.

expect: Writes a style brief: rhythm, easing, composition, typography, color roles, materials
Maps reference color roles onto the brand palette
Uses the user logo, never the reference logo
Side-by-side comparison at matching moments
failIf: Copies the reference logo, characters or branded artwork

tasks.title: Arabic script with an image reference
expect: Detects Arabic
Uses an open Arabic font (not a Kurdish one)
Right-to-left layout and correct shaping
failIf: Kurdish font used for Arabic text

tasks.title: Talking head with explicit instructions

input.instructions: Trim the first 3 seconds, reframe to 9:16, normalize loudness, burn in captions from captions.srt.

expect: Does exactly the four requested operations, nothing extra
Original file unchanged; new export in mp2/
Loudness within 1 LU of the target

tasks.title: Footage with no instructions
expect: Inspects the footage first
Proposes a numbered edit plan with reasons and waits for approval
Mentions automatic subtle motion is on and how to turn it off

tasks.title: Sorani captions on footage

input.instructions: Add Sorani captions and punch in on key sentences.

expect: Captions shaped right-to-left with an open Kurdish-capable font
Punch-ins of 110 to 120 % on emphasized lines
Captions inside the platform safe area

tasks.title: Persian detection and font choice

input.script: سه راه برای شروع بهتر روز.

expect: Detects Persian
Uses an open Persian-capable font chosen by style
Persian digits and ZWNJ preserved

tasks.title: Font choice follows style
expect: Picks a playful open font (for example a rounded family) via the recommender
One primary font for the whole video
Says which font and why in one line
failIf: Uses a machine-specific system font by default

tasks.title: 30-second SaaS promo with missing screenshots (motion and design rules)

input.script: Your team is drowning in busywork. Updates in five apps. Reports by hand. Deadlines slipping away. Meet Flowly. One workspace that runs your projects for you. Tasks assign themselves, based on who has time. Reports build in one click, always up to date. Teams save ten hours every week. Try Flowly free today. Work less. Ship more.
input.notes: Brand colours #F7F8FC, #0F172A, #4F46E5, #22D3A5. The screenshots and logo the user mentions are not supplied.

expect: Says which files are missing and draws stand-in UI, cards, avatars and charts in code instead of falling back to text
Every scene demonstrates its sentence (e.g. task cards fly to avatars, a report builds, a counter climbs to 10 hrs)
6-8 scenes of 2-5 s, a visual event every 1-2 s, eased staggered motion and designed transitions
Brand colours used exactly and one consistent style
pnpm tempoloom media pacing passes on the final MP4
Delivers the MP4 with one line per scene describing what happens
failIf: Any scene is only text on a plain background
Anything on screen is still for more than 1.5 s
Fades through an empty frame between scenes
Delivers a script, prompt or slideshow instead of a rendered video

tasks.title: Promo from a product page, no script

input.request: Make a 30 second video for https://example.com/product

expect: Runs `tempoloom write URL --seconds 30` and reads the brief
Writes the script from the brief: hook first, call to action last, one sentence a line
Every figure, price and quotation comes from the brief's facts
`write --check` passes before showing the script
Shows the script for approval before `make`
failIf: Invents a figure, customer, review, quotation or superlative
Runs make before the user approves the script

tasks.title: Kurdish video from a topic only

input.request: ڤیدیۆیەک دروست بکە دەربارەی چۆنیەتی زیادکردنی کڕیار بۆ دوکانە بچووکەکان

expect: Runs `tempoloom write` with the topic in Sorani
Writes the script in Sorani Arabic script, as people speak
Names no figures, prices, results or quotations (a topic has no facts)
`write --check` passes before showing the script
failIf: Invents a figure or a result
